title: VASP full characterization
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-full-characterization workflow: it characterizes one material by running the vasp-relax, vasp-band-structure, vasp-dos, vasp-elastic, vasp-eos, vasp-dielectric (insulators only) and vasp-phonons workflows as child jobs, each under its own declaration, on one shared tight relaxation and its standardized cell, without running any VASP calculation twice: the density of states reads the band structure's self-consistent charge density, and the phonons read the dielectric response's Born effective charges.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure to characterize.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the tightly relaxed structure, the CONTCAR of the relaxation child; output role standardized_structure is a structures entry containing the cell every property child starts from, the HPKOT primitive cell of the relaxed structure, or the relaxed structure itself when standardize is false; and output role characterization is a files entry containing characterization.json, every child job (id, key, outcome) and the decisions taken (the insulator decision from the relaxation's band gap, which children ran and with what).

outputs.name: relaxed_structure
outputs.description: The tightly relaxed structure: the CONTCAR of the relaxation child.

outputs.name: standardized_structure
outputs.description: The cell every property child starts from: the HPKOT primitive cell of the relaxed structure, or the relaxed structure itself when standardize is false.

outputs.name: characterization
outputs.description: characterization.json: every child job (id, key, outcome) and the decisions taken (the insulator decision from the relaxation's band gap, which children ran and with what).
